evals.prompt: Our IC approved a Series B in a US digital therapeutics company on 1 September 2026. The thesis rested on: (1) its FDA clearance stays in place, (2) it keeps running randomized trials, (3) no new safety events, (4) the company hits USD 20 million revenue next year. Set up what we should monitor. Pick sensible thresholds for us.
evals.expected_output: Writes the four assumptions back verbatim with memo date 1 September 2026. Matches signals and limits: (1) authorizations and new authorization or recall events via build_company_profile and get_deltas, but no marketing status is stored, so 'stays in place' is only partly measurable; (2) registered studies by link tier and evidence maturity components, registry only, rubric v1 dated 7 October 2026 after the memo (T4 unless recorded); (3) safety events via get_deltas, with the log start 12 October 2026 after the memo date (T5); (4) not measurable from the record (T3), revenue needs the person's own non-public data. Declines to pick thresholds: offers any as 'proposed', not applied until confirmed; triggers not given. Owners not named (T1), reread dates not given (T2); asks, no job titles. Notes filing clocks as facts (8-K four business days DL-019; Form D 15 days DL-002). Does not call or set a watch. Short mode under 450 words; record line is the very last line.
